engine.cell_fidelity_note: typed protocol: cells carry their JSON/driver types.

fix_test_text: unified diff of the changed test files, from the GitHub API; truncated to 20480 bytes per issue

fix_lookup_values.closing_commit: sha came from the issue's closed event
fix_lookup_values.referenced_commit: sha came from a referenced event only
fix_lookup_values.pull_request: fix found through a pull request
fix_lookup_values.closing_commit_unreachable: sha named by the API but not reachable in the repo: fix_files and fix_test_text are UNAVAILABLE, not empty
fix_lookup_values.referenced_commit_unreachable: referenced sha not reachable in the repo: fix_files and fix_test_text are UNAVAILABLE, not empty
fix_lookup_values.none: the API exposed no fix at all; fix_sha is UNKNOWN

fix_pr_source_values.api: GitHub linked the pull request itself
fix_pr_source_values.commit_subject: parsed from the squash-merge '(#N)' convention in the commit subject: a convention, not a confirmation
